Richter Junior Competition — всеукраїнсь: Richter Junior Competition is a Ukraine-wide competition for young musicians, created in Zhytomyr for solo performers aged 10 to 13. The Competition brings together four specialties — piano, violin, cello, and flute — and combines an online selection round with a live performance by the finalists.
Richter Junior Competition — можливість: Richter Junior Competition is a chance to make yourself known nationwide, go through a professional competitive selection, receive an assessment from an international jury, and perform at the final gala concert in the birthplace of Sviatoslav Richter.
Richter — міжнародно впізнавана форма пр: Richter is the internationally recognized form of Sviatoslav Richter's surname, known to the global music community. Using the Latin alphabet in the name doesn't distance the pianist's figure from Ukraine. On the contrary, it helps communicate the artist's Zhytomyr origins in a language understood by an international audience.
Ім'я Ріхтера в назві конкурсу — це не де: Richter's name in the Competition's title is not decoration but a guiding principle: respect for music, a high standard of performance culture, the courage to think boldly, and responsibility to the listener.
директор Музичної школи ім. Святослава Р: Director of the Sviatoslav Richter Music School
Людмила Кочевенко — викладач-методист по: Liudmyla Kochevenko is a teacher-methodologist for piano and Director of the Sviatoslav Richter Music School. She is an Honored Culture Worker of Ukraine and a recipient of the "For Merits to the City of Zhytomyr" award.
Провідний експерт у галузі початкової ми: A leading expert in primary arts education and developer of educational standards, she is an experienced educator and a jury member at national and international music competitions. Her many years of teaching have focused on discovering and nurturing young talents, raising a new generation of Ukrainian performers, and comprehensively modernizing the educational process in arts institutions.
В основі її методики лежить виховання ви: Her teaching method is built on cultivating a high standard of performance culture, attention to technical mastery, and a deep understanding of stylistic nuance — from classical to contemporary repertoire. Graduates of her class go on to study at leading institutions of higher arts education and build successful careers as professional musicians.
За період педагогічної діяльності вихова: Over the course of her career she has mentored numerous prize-winning students, Grand Prix holders, and winners of prestigious national and international instrumental competitions, and has also prepared three recipients of the mayor's scholarship, awarded for outstanding achievement in music.
Регулярно бере участь у складі журі міжн: She regularly serves as an independent expert on the juries of international and national competitions, is one of the authors of Ukraine's educational programme for the elementary level of primary arts education, and conducts her own master classes, seminars, and methodological consultations for music school teachers.
Ганна Федорченко — викладач-методист вищ: Hanna Fedorchenko is a top-category teacher-methodologist for violin at the Lesia Ukrainka Music School of Zhytomyr City Council, a teacher at the V. S. Kosenko Zhytomyr Music Vocational College, head of the "Orchestral String Instruments" subject committee, and mentor of the first children's orchestra, Richter Kids.
Понад усе у своїй професійній діяльності: Above all, her professional work focuses on nurturing creative personality, developing the performance skills of young violinists, and instilling in them a love of academic music. She successfully combines teaching, methodological work, and concert performance, introducing modern approaches to music education.
Як наставниця першого дитячого оркестру: As mentor of the first children's orchestra, Richter Kids, she works to develop ensemble and orchestral performance skills, giving children opportunities for creative self-realization and participation in concert projects, festivals, and competitions. Her students are laureates of national and international competitions and go on to professional training at Ukraine's leading arts institutions.
Ганна Федорченко постійно підвищує профе: Hanna Fedorchenko continuously develops her professional qualifications, taking part in methodological conferences, master classes, and arts projects, contributing to the development of modern music education and the promotion of the Ukrainian performance school.
Джорджо Гасбарро закінчив консерваторію: Giorgio Gasbarro, after graduating from the "V. Виступав для провідних музичних асоціаці: He has performed for major music associations in various chamber ensembles and as a soloist with the Teatro Massimo Orchestra, the Orchestra da Camera Siciliana, the "Gli Armonici" Orchestra, the Orchestra of the Accademia Musicale Siciliana, and the "Archiensemble." Гастролював Європою, Китаєм, Японією, Пі: He has toured throughout Europe, China, Japan, South America, and Australia, and has taken part in international festivals such as Lucerne, Casablanca, El Djem, Shanghai, Malta, and Montepulciano. Since 2006 he has also been a member of the Trio Siciliano.
Олена Кущій народилася 7 червня 1981 рок: Elena Kushchii was born on June 7, 1981 in Ukraine, in the city of Dnipro. At the age of 5 she began studying flute with Maestro Tamara Shaposhnikova. At the age of 16 she entered the Dnepropetrovsk Musical College "Glinka" and became a student of Maestro S.D. Pyatov. In 1999 she entered the Kharkiv University of Arts "Kotlyarevsky" under the guidance of Maestro A.V. Voinov.
У 2004 році з відзнакою закінчила Харків: In 2004 she graduated from the Kharkiv National University of Arts with the highest honors, and in 2007 she earned a specialization as a "soloist" at the same university, again with the highest honors. Since 1997 she has worked in various orchestras as principal flute, also covering piccolo duties. From 2012 to 2018 she was Concertmaster of the flutes and solo flute in the Kharkiv Philharmonic Orchestra, and in 2016 she received a certificate of honor from the mayor of Kharkiv for her high level of professionalism and her significant contribution to the city's socio-cultural development.
У 2019 році перемогла на конкурсі на пос: In 2019 she won the competition for the position of Concertmaster of the flutes and soloist at the Odessa National Academic Theatre of Opera and Ballet. In 2021 she was principal flute in Hans Zimmer's orchestra, touring with it in France, Belgium, Germany, and Abu Dhabi. In 2022 she held, simultaneously with her position at the Odessa National Opera Theatre, the role of Principal Solo Flute in the Symphony Orchestra of the Metropolitan City of Bari. Since 2023 she has held the role of Principal Solo Flute of the Klassiske Philharmonia Bonn, performing on tour in the most important theaters of Spain, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Poland.
До її репертуару входять Сюїта сі мінор: Her repertoire includes Bach's Suite in B minor, Mozart's two flute concertos (in G major and D major), Khachaturian's Violin Concerto (in a transcription for flute approved by Khachaturian himself), Jules Mouquet's La flûte de Pan, and Gluck's Orfeo ed Euridice. Since 2018 she has performed in trio and quartet formations with pianist and composer Maurizio Bignone.

Мауріціо Біньйоне здобув освіту альтиста: A graduate in viola from the "V. Bellini" Conservatory of Music in Palermo, Maurizio Bignone has years of experience performing with numerous orchestras, including as principal viola, while simultaneously studying piano. Today he is an Italian pianist and composer with a distinctive crossover sensibility, recognized as one of the most interesting and original voices on the international neoclassical scene.
Його музика — це ніколи не просто викона: His music is never mere performance, but a cathartic experience that "whispers to the soul" of the listener, combining the rigor of classical training with a modern, visceral, and deeply communicative melodic line. At the heart of his artistic vision vibrates a symbiotic relationship with nature: his compositions draw their essence from primordial sensations and the wonders of the natural world, transforming them into a sonic flow capable of generating immediate emotional wellbeing.

Його музика одразу знайшла відгук на сві: His music has found immediate resonance in the global market. Ці результати відкрили двері на одні з н: These results translated into appearances at some of the world's most prestigious festivals and concert halls, including Womad, the Festival dei Due Mondi in Spoleto, and the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam, as well as events such as the Amici della Musica of Palermo, Novara, and Milan, the Conservatories of Palermo, Perugia, and Bari, the Aaron Copland School in New York, the Novosibirsk Contemporary Music Festival, the Round Top Festival (Texas), the Gramado Festival (Brazil), and the Orestiadi di Gibellina.
Його твори виконують всесвітньо визнані: His compositions are performed by internationally acclaimed soloists, including violinist Laurentius Dinca and the Berlin Philharmonic Soloists, pianist Gilda Buttà and cellist Luca Pincini (Morricone's soloists), American trumpeter Ralph Alessi, American violist Brett Deubner, violist Dennis Krasnokutsky (Philadelphia Virtuosi Chamber), Serbian soloist Maja Rajkovich, cellist Maya Fridman, jazz pianist Rita Marcotulli, the Tan'g Quartet of Singapore, the Trio Siciliano (principal players of the Teatro Massimo Orchestra in Palermo), the Hirokyo Cellos (Hiroshima Symphony Orchestra), the Novosibirsk Philharmonic Chamber Orchestra, and the Astana Opera Theatre, among many other international ensembles.
Свідченням успіху, що поєднує композитор: As a testament to a success that combines compositional rigor with broad accessibility, Maurizio can today count on a solid international fan base: over 50,000 followers on Instagram and 9,000 on Facebook, an active community that translates into a steady audience presence at his concerts.
No Border: проєкт камерної музики: No Border: The Chamber Music Project
У 2019 році народився гастрольний проєкт: In 2019, "No Border" was born, a touring project featuring Maurizio Bignone performing alongside flutist Elena Kushchii (Concertmaster flute and soloist of the Odessa National Opera and Ballet Theatre) and cellist Giorgio Gasbarro (former principal cellist of the Teatro Massimo in Palermo and performer with the Sicilian Symphony Orchestra).

З 2022 року Мауріціо працює над сольним: Since 2022, Maurizio has been engaged in the solo piano project "Inner Reflections," an intense musical journey in which the artist explores, with passion and a sensitive spirit — at times wild and dreamlike — the limits of human nature in relation to the elements of nature and to himself.
Тур уже відбувся — незмінно з великим ус: The tour has already reached, always with great success and numerous sold-out shows, cities such as Odessa, Kyiv, Dnipro, Lviv, Ivano-Frankivsk, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Uzhhorod, Lutsk, Marsala, Palermo, Rome, Amsterdam, Hamburg, Dannenberg, Salzwedel, Hitzacker, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Astana, and Almaty. Particularly significant was his debut in Odessa in November 2021, with the concert selling out within days and ending in a standing ovation.
7 листопада 2025 року Мауріціо вперше де: On November 7, 2025, Maurizio made his debut in London for the first time, a milestone that confirmed the strength of the project even in the most competitive venues. This London success paves the way for the upcoming German tour scheduled for October 2026, which will bring him for the first time to Berlin, Frankfurt, Cologne, and Munich, alongside a return to Hamburg — further consolidating his presence within the major European music circuits.
